name: mcp-notes
description: Adds governed MCP tools, a prompt and a resource for an editorial `notes` collection.

tools.name: countNotes
tools.description: Count the notes on an item.

tools.name: appendNote
tools.description: Append an editorial note to an item.

tools.name: addNotesField
tools.description: Add a field to the notes collection. Always needs a human approval (schema:write).

prompts.name: note-style
prompts.title: Editorial note style
prompts.text: Notes are one sentence, imperative mood, and name the field they concern.

resources.name: notes-guide
resources.title: How editors use notes
resources.text:
# Notes

A note is a short instruction from an editor to the author of an item.
